Quick read-aloud — the party crests the last rise and sees Greenrest. Full first-sight handout in @UUID[JournalEntry.Sul8MunzAk2IWGQ4.JournalEntryPage.4lKriTUSmlyIdB37]{First Sight of Greenrest}, with the two images to show the table — @UUID[JournalEntry.Sul8MunzAk2IWGQ4.JournalEntryPage.d64IpbrUOhKT8UOS]{The View from the Hill} (the hilltop vista) and @UUID[JournalEntry.Sul8MunzAk2IWGQ4.JournalEntryPage.9LzEpTF6dKRqDd7C]{The Village of Greenrest} (the town map) — all in Player Handouts.

The trees thin, the trail climbs one last rise, and the forest lets you go — the mist simply ends, burned off in clean gold sunlight. Below you, cradled in green meadows under a cloudless sky, sits the village of Greenrest, and after so many dripping days beneath the canopy it looks almost too tidy to be true. Slate roofs cluster snug around a market square, chimney-smoke rises straight up, orchards and hedged fields quilt the slopes down to a flat, silver-blue lake — birdsong, cut hay, woodsmoke, and the plain, startling relief of open sky. To your right an old stone watchtower keeps the height, a worn path spilling from its foot down to the road. Only one thing snags the eye: at the very heart of the village, alone in all that green, stands a single great tree gone grey and sickly — the one wrong note in an otherwise perfect song.
